name: serumv1-preset-generator
description: Validates and writes Xfer Serum 1 (.fxp) presets — no model, no API key.
long_description: Writes and edits real Xfer Serum 1 .fxp preset files directly on disk. You (the calling model) design the sound; this server only validates it against a verified Parameter Reference and writes the file, byte-tested against the factory library. No model call and no API key live anywhere in this process. Open source (MIT); see the README for the full tool list and known limitations.

serum_root.title: Serum 1 presets folder (optional)
serum_root.description: Your Serum 1 preset library root (the folder containing Presets/ and Tables/). Leave empty to use the standard macOS install location.
